projection.commandLine: ogrinfo -q -dialect SQLITE -sql SELECT id AS id, ST_Line_Locate_Point(GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-8 6,40 42)'), MakePoint(CAST(x AS REAL),CAST(y AS REAL))) AS frac, ST_Distance(GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-8 6,40 42)'), MakePoint(CAST(x AS REAL),CAST(y AS REAL))) AS dist FROM "profile-section" validation/cross-implementation/profile/profile-section.csv

clampNote: ST_Line_Locate_Point clamps to [0, 1], so frac * length is the chainage beside the line and the nearer endpoint past an end.
